verdicts.reason: A is broken. The text has been pulled out of the label frame, so the white label holds nothing but its orphaned divider rules and dashes. 'J'adore Paris', 'LAVANDER' and 'SKINCARE' are scattered down the left side and 'HOMEMADE LOTION' floats at the top right. The illustrations are shrunk into a small cluttered row, so it no longer reads as the same design. B keeps the label intact, with all copy inside it in the original order. However, the label's divider rules have come loose and float empty at the top right, colliding with the lavender illustration. The illustrations are scattered unevenly, with a cramped bottom-centre bowl and small stray soap pieces. 'SKINCARE' is tiny, and the label is too small for the banner, so the brand gets little prominence.
